_help: One entry per perk effect. text tokens: {v} total of all placed perks, {u} amount one perk gives, {c} trigger chance, {m} 1 + node count, {x} base minus total, {d} double the total, {h} half the total. kind: add (sums per node) or flag (on/off, place once). chance: optional trigger chance in percent (1 to 100, missing means guaranteed); every placed perk rolls on its own; text without {c} gets an N% chance lead-in. scope: S self, E enemies through you, X shared enemy modifier. tier key marks a keystone with a built-in cost. keywords: native keyword ids this perk mentions (they feed the mod's effect catalog and the companion tooltips). percent: true when unit is in percent points and the mod stores it as a fraction (25 becomes 0.25).

perks.name: Thorned
perks.text: Start each combat with {v} Thorns.

perks.name: Anchored
perks.text: Start each combat with {v} Block.

perks.name: Swift Defense
perks.text: When you take damage, {c}% chance to instantly gain {u} Block.
perks.note: Counts damage that gets past your Block, from any source including your own perks. The Block arrives after the hit, so it helps against the rest of a multi-hit attack and the next attacker, not the hit that triggered it.

perks.name: Mighty
perks.text: Start each combat with {v} Strength.

perks.name: Supple
perks.text: Start combat with +{v} Dexterity.

perks.name: Ferocious
perks.text: Start each combat with {v} Vigor.

perks.name: Warding
perks.text: Start each combat with {v} Artifact.

perks.name: Warded
perks.text: Start each combat with {v} Buffer.

perks.name: Afterimage
perks.text: Start each combat with {v} Blur.

perks.name: Regenerating
perks.text: Gain {v} Regen at the start of combat.

perks.name: Vital
perks.text: Heal {v} HP on your first turn each combat.

perks.name: Healing
perks.text: At the start of your turn, restore {v} HP.

perks.name: Healthy
perks.text: Gain {v} Max HP.
perks.note: Applied when you enter the next room after the perk is locked in, never while it is only pending.

perks.name: Intimidating
perks.text: On your first turn, apply {v} Vulnerable to ALL enemies.

perks.name: Gilded
perks.text: Start each combat with {v} Strength per 300 Gold you hold.

perks.name: Renewing
perks.text: The first time your HP falls to 50% or below each combat, gain {v} Block.
perks.note: With a chance below 100%, a failed roll does not use this up: each later HP loss while you are at half HP or below tries again, until one succeeds. Once per combat.

perks.name: Enduring
perks.text: From turn 5 on, gain {v} Strength at the start of each turn.

perks.name: Preemptive
perks.text: On your first turn, {c}% chance to draw {u} extra card(s).

perks.name: Prepared
perks.text: On your first turn, {c}% chance to gain {u} Energy.

perks.name: Clean
perks.text: At the start of your turn, {c}% chance to Exhaust up to {u} card(s) from your hand.
perks.note: You choose which card, or none. The chance is rolled first; the choice only appears when it succeeds.

perks.name: Picky
perks.text: At the start of your turn, {c}% chance to discard up to {u} card(s) from your hand.
perks.note: You choose which card, or none. It is a real discard, so Cycling and the other discard perks react.

perks.name: Savage
perks.text: Once per turn, when you play a zero-cost Attack, {c}% chance to instantly return it to your hand.
perks.note: Every zero-cost Attack you play can roll until one succeeds, then no more that turn. A card that would Exhaust comes back to your hand instead (it exhausts as normal if you play it again). X-cost cards and cards played for you by other effects do not count.

perks.name: Cornered
perks.text: While at 50% HP or below, draw {v} extra card(s) each turn.

perks.name: Invigorated
perks.text: Gain {v} Vigor at the start of each turn.

perks.name: Quicksilver
perks.text: At the start of each turn, deal {v} damage to ALL enemies.

perks.name: Rhythmic
perks.text: Every 4th turn, gain {v} Energy. The count runs across the whole run.

perks.name: Accelerating
perks.text: Every 12th Attack you play (counted across the run) gives {v} Energy.

perks.name: Insightful
perks.text: The first time unblocked damage hits you each combat, draw {v} card(s).
perks.note: With a chance below 100%, a failed roll does not use this up: the next hit that gets past your Block tries again, until one succeeds. Once per combat.

perks.name: Bladed
perks.text: For every 4 Skills you play in a turn, deal {v} damage to ALL enemies.

perks.name: Relentless
perks.text: For every 4 Attacks you play in a turn, gain {v} Strength.

perks.name: Gusting
perks.text: For every 4 Attacks you play in a turn, gain {v} Block.

perks.name: Darting
perks.text: For every 4 Attacks you play in a turn, gain {v} Dexterity.

perks.name: Tempered
perks.text: If you end your turn with no Block, gain {v} Block.

perks.name: Retaining
perks.text: At the end of your turn, Retain {v} extra random card(s).

perks.name: Studious
perks.text: The first Power you play each combat draws {v} cards.
perks.note: With a chance below 100%, a failed roll does not use this up: the next Power you play tries again, until one succeeds. Once per combat.

perks.name: Overflowing
perks.text: The first Power you play each turn gives {v} Energy.
perks.note: With a chance below 100%, a failed roll does not use up the turn: the next Power you play that turn tries again, until one succeeds. Once per turn.

perks.name: Cunning
perks.text: Playing a Skill has a {c}% chance to draw {u} card(s).

perks.name: Supply
perks.text: When you play a card, add a copy of it to your hand. It gains Ethereal and Exhaust.

perks.name: Tenacious
perks.text: {c}% chance a card that would Exhaust is discarded instead.

perks.name: Persistent
perks.text: An Ethereal card that would Exhaust is discarded instead.

perks.name: Plundering
perks.text: Gain {v} Gold for each enemy you kill.

perks.name: Cash Flow
perks.text: At the end of combat, get a separate reward of {v} Gold.

perks.name: Finishing
perks.text: Gain {v} Block for each enemy you kill.

perks.name: Executing
perks.text: Deal {v}% more damage to enemies at 20% HP or less.
perks.note: Skips the perks' own flat damage (pings, Discharge), so it will not compound with them.

perks.name: Adrenal
perks.text: When unblocked damage hits you, {c}% chance to gain {u} Energy.

perks.name: Contagious
perks.text: When you kill a Vulnerable enemy, its Vulnerable, Weak, Frail and Poison spread to another enemy.

perks.name: Resonant
perks.text: Whenever you gain Strength or Dexterity, gain {v} more (up to 3 times a turn).
perks.note: Only a bonus that actually happens counts toward the 3 a turn; a failed roll leaves the limit alone.

perks.name: Obstinate
perks.text: Strength and Dexterity reductions enemies apply to you become gains.

perks.name: Discharging
perks.text: Whenever you gain bonus Energy, deal {v} damage to ALL enemies per Energy gained.

perks.name: Immolating
perks.text: Gain 1 Energy each turn. Lose 5 HP at the start of each combat.

perks.name: Overclocked
perks.text: Gain 1 Energy each turn. Lose 1 Max HP at the start of each combat, permanently.
perks.note: The Max HP loss repeats every combat for the rest of the run. Check the totals before keeping it.

perks.name: Echoing
perks.text: Each turn, a random card in your hand gains Replay 1. Playing it gives you 1 Vulnerable and 1 Frail.

perks.name: Eroding
perks.text: Each turn, move one enemy power 1 toward zero. Buffs and debuffs both, including your teammates' debuffs.
perks.note: A gamble by design: it strips debuffs your team put on enemies too.

perks.name: Exposing
perks.text: At combat start, apply {v} Vulnerable to one enemy and to yourself.

perks.name: Enervating
perks.text: At combat start, apply {v} Weak to one enemy and to yourself.

perks.name: Chaotic
perks.text: Each turn, {c}% chance to apply {u} Vulnerable, Weak or Frail to a random enemy or to yourself.

perks.name: Bribing
perks.text: Enemy hits deal 1 less damage and cost you 5 Gold each time.

perks.name: Catalytic
perks.text: Your other perks' random chances trigger {m}x as often.

perks.name: Priming
perks.text: Add {v} points to your other perks' random chances.

perks.name: Empowering
perks.text: Your other perks' random chances get a second roll.

perks.name: Bolstering
perks.text: Your combat-start Artifact, Buffer and Blur perks give {v} more each.

perks.name: Concentrated
perks.text: Your potion-use perk effects are doubled.

perks.name: Refined
perks.text: Each of your potion-use perk amounts gets +{v}.

perks.name: Alchemical
perks.text: When you use a potion, gain {v} Block.

perks.name: Fermented
perks.text: When you use a potion, gain {v} Strength.

perks.name: Distilled
perks.text: When you use a potion, gain {v} Dexterity.

perks.name: Corrosive
perks.text: When you use a potion, apply {v} Vulnerable to ALL enemies.

perks.name: Diluting
perks.text: When you use a potion, apply {v} Weak to ALL enemies.

perks.name: Hidden Dose
perks.text: When you use a potion, apply {v} Poison to ALL enemies.

perks.name: Effervescent
perks.text: When you use a potion, {c}% chance to gain {u} Buffer.

perks.name: Potion+
perks.text: Gain {v} extra Potion slot(s).
perks.note: Applied when you enter a room after committing the perk. Refunding it takes the slot back only once the slot is empty, so a potion is never lost.

perks.name: Potionholic
perks.text: After combat, {c}% chance to find {u} extra potion(s) on the rewards screen.
perks.note: Each success is its own potion reward from the game's normal potion pool. If your belt is full it just stays on the screen, like a normal potion drop.

perks.name: Acidic
perks.text: When you use a potion, deal {v} damage to ALL enemies.

perks.name: Recycler
perks.text: When you use a potion in combat, {c}% chance to refund it instantly.
perks.note: At most one potion comes back per use, however many Recyclers succeed. It goes into the first empty slot, so a full belt (for example after Entropic Brew) gets nothing. Potions used outside combat are never refunded.

perks.name: Cursefed
perks.text: Once a turn, drawing a Curse gives {v} Strength or Dexterity (coin flip).
perks.note: With a chance below 100%, a failed roll does not use up the turn: the next Curse you draw that turn tries again, until one succeeds. Once per turn.

perks.name: Attuned
perks.text: At combat start, gain {v} Block per relic you carry (total capped at 8).

perks.name: Cursebound
perks.text: At combat start, gain stats by the Curse cards in your deck: 1: +1 Str. 2: +1 Str, +1 Dex. 3: +2/+2. 4: +3/+2. 5+: +3/+3 and Intangible 1.
perks.note: Each node applies the whole package, so two nodes double it, Intangible included.

perks.name: Calloused
perks.text: Vulnerable is {v} points less effective on you. (+50% damage taken becomes +{x}%.)
perks.note: New-design effect, name is a placeholder. Capped at the size of the vanilla debuff.

perks.name: Unbowed
perks.text: Weak is {v} points less effective on you. (-25% damage dealt becomes -{x}%.)
perks.note: New-design effect, name is a placeholder. Capped at the size of the vanilla debuff.

perks.name: Unshaken
perks.text: Frail is {v} points less effective on you. (-25% Block gained becomes -{x}%.)
perks.note: New-design effect, name is a placeholder. Capped at the size of the vanilla debuff.

perks.name: Quenched
perks.text: Each Vigor you spend: {c}% chance to gain {u} Strength.

perks.name: Bracing
perks.text: Each Vigor you spend: {c}% chance to gain {u} Block.

perks.name: Rending
perks.text: Each Vigor you spend: {c}% chance to apply {u} Vulnerable to a random enemy.

perks.name: Withering
perks.text: Each Vigor you spend: {c}% chance to apply {u} Weak to a random enemy.

perks.name: Stoking
perks.text: Each Vigor you spend: {c}% chance to gain {u} Energy.

perks.name: Wellspring
perks.text: Each Vigor you spend: {c}% chance to gain {u} Regen.

perks.name: Surging
perks.text: Gaining Vigor gives 1 more (up to 3 times a turn).
perks.note: Only a bonus that actually happens counts toward the 3 a turn; a failed roll leaves the limit alone.

perks.name: Congealing
perks.text: At end of turn, each unused Vigor turns into {v} Block
perks.note: The number is Block per unused Vigor: 1 is one for one, 2 is double, 0.2 is 1 Block for every 5 Vigor. Several nodes add together.

perks.name: Evolving
perks.text: At the end of your turn, consume unused Vigor: each point has a {c}% chance to give {u} Strength.

perks.name: Frenzied
perks.text: Your Vigor-spending perks get an extra try on every failed roll. Each Vigor you spend: {c}% chance to deal {u} damage to you.
perks.note: Real damage, so Block soaks it, and it can kill you at 1 HP. The extra try does not apply to the turn-end Vigor perks.

perks.name: Cindered
perks.text: Whenever a card is Exhausted, gain {v} Block.

perks.name: Bloodforged
perks.text: The first time you lose HP each combat, gain {v} Strength.
perks.note: With a chance below 100%, a failed roll does not use this up: each later HP loss tries again, until one succeeds. Once per combat.

perks.name: Gouging
perks.text: When you apply Vulnerable, {c}% chance to apply {u} more.

perks.name: Retaliating
perks.text: At the start of each turn, gain Vigor equal to {h}x the HP you lost since your last turn.

perks.name: Envenomed
perks.text: When you apply Poison, {c}% chance to apply {u} more.

perks.name: Toxic Ward
perks.text: When you apply Poison to an enemy, {c}% chance to gain {u} Block.
perks.note: Rolls once for every enemy you poison, so Hidden Dose over three enemies is three rolls. Poison from Envenomed's bonus copy does not count.

perks.name: Poison Cloud
perks.text: When you apply Poison to an enemy, {c}% chance to deal {u} damage to it.
perks.note: The damage goes to the enemy you just poisoned, not to all enemies. It is flat, so Strength and Vulnerable do not change it.

perks.name: Flurrying
perks.text: Playing a Shiv has a {c}% chance to add {u} Shiv to your hand.

perks.name: Cycling
perks.text: When you discard a card, draw {v} card(s).

perks.name: Retrieving
perks.text: {c}% chance an Exhausted Shiv returns to your hand.

perks.name: Focused
perks.text: The first time you gain Focus each combat, gain {v} more.
perks.note: With a chance below 100%, a failed roll does not use this up: the next Focus you gain tries again, until one succeeds. Once per combat.

perks.name: Focal
perks.text: When you gain Focus, {c}% chance to gain {u} more.

perks.name: Amplified
perks.text: When you Channel an Orb, {c}% chance to Channel {u} random Orb(s) too.

perks.name: Supercharged
perks.text: While your Orb slots are full, gain {v} Focus.

perks.name: Preheated
perks.text: Channel {v} random Orb(s) at the start of combat.

perks.name: Charged
perks.text: Channel {v} Lightning Orb(s) at the start of combat.

perks.name: Chilled
perks.text: Channel {v} Frost Orb(s) at the start of combat.

perks.name: Shadowed
perks.text: Channel {v} Dark Orb(s) at the start of combat.

perks.name: Ionized
perks.text: Channel {v} Plasma Orb(s) at the start of combat.

perks.name: Glazed
perks.text: Channel {v} Glass Orb(s) at the start of combat.

perks.name: Necromantic
perks.text: Whenever you Summon, gain {v} Block.

perks.name: Dooming
perks.text: When you apply Doom, apply {v} more.

perks.name: Bonebound
perks.text: Summon {v} at the start of each turn.

perks.name: Undying
perks.text: Doom no longer kills you outright. The next HP you lose kills you instead, if Doom still stands at or above your HP.
perks.note: Rewrites a core death rule. Audit asks for it about 30 allocated points from a start node.

perks.name: Vengeful
perks.text: At the start of each turn, Summon {v}x the HP you lost since your last turn, rounded down.

perks.name: Empathic
perks.text: At the start of each turn, gain Block equal to the HP your summon lost.

perks.name: Starlit
perks.text: Gain {v} Star(s) at the start of your turn.

perks.name: Reforging
perks.text: When you Forge, {c}% chance to gain {v} Star(s).

perks.name: Regal
perks.text: When you spend Stars, {c}% chance to refund {u}.

perks.name: Tributary
perks.text: When you Forge, {c}% chance to draw {u} card(s).

perks.name: Bellows
perks.text: At the start of your turn, {c}% chance to Forge {u}.
perks.note: Every Bellows rolls on its own. The Forge counts as yours, so Reforging, Tributary and Regal react to it.

perks.name: Steel
perks.text: At the start of combat, {c}% chance to Forge {u}.
perks.note: Happens just before your first turn, so the Sovereign Blade is ready in your hand. Each Steel rolls on its own.

perks.name: Riposte
perks.text: Gain {u} Block when you Forge.
perks.note: Any Forge counts, including Bellows, Steel and Mastercraft.

perks.name: Mastercraft
perks.text: When you attack with Sovereign Blade, Forge {v}.
perks.note: Forges after the attack, so the extra damage is for the next swing. Meant as a capstone; place it on a capstone node.

perks.name: Aligned
perks.text: On your first turn, {c}% chance to gain {u} Star(s).

perks.name: Bountiful
perks.text: When you gain Stars, {c}% chance to gain {u} more.

perks.name: Prodigy
perks.text: When you Channel an Orb, {c}% chance to gain {u} temporary Focus.
perks.note: Temporary: the Focus comes off at the end of the turn, the way Hotfix's does. Every Orb you channel counts, including ones other perks channel (Amplified, Charged...). Focal and Focused react to the Focus it gives. Meant as a capstone; place it on a capstone node.

perks.name: Thoughtful
perks.text: When you Channel an Orb, {c}% chance to gain {u} Block.
perks.note: Every Orb you channel counts, including ones other perks channel (Amplified, Charged...).

perks.name: Quick Tune
perks.text: At the start of your turn, {c}% chance to gain {u} temporary Focus.
perks.note: Temporary: the Focus comes off at the end of the turn, the way Hotfix's does. Focal and Focused react to the Focus it gives.
